title: Source content
description: Ordered source content preserving text, nested elements, and attributes. The tags use OSIS-equivalent semantics for supported source formats; unrecognized source constructs are retained. Reference bodies belong to chapter reference; nested footnote bodies belong to editorial footnotes. Their content nodes link by reference_id or footnote_id in attrs. This is structural content, never executable HTML.

attrs.description: Source attributes retained as strings. Content links use reference_id or footnote_id to identify chapter study entries.
